change_feed_actor_ck.name: change_feed_actor_ck
change_feed_actor_ck.value: CASE "change_feed"."actor_kind" WHEN 'user' THEN "change_feed"."actor_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "change_feed"."actor_run_id" IS NULL WHEN 'system' THEN "change_feed"."actor_user_id" IS NULL AND "change_feed"."actor_run_id" IS NULL ELSE "change_feed"."actor_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "change_feed"."actor_run_id" IS NOT NULL END

delivery_runs_outcome_ended_ck.name: delivery_runs_outcome_ended_ck
delivery_runs_outcome_ended_ck.value: "delivery_runs"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL OR ("delivery_runs"."verdict" IS NULL AND "delivery_runs"."failure" IS NULL)

delivery_runs_merged_verdict_ck.name: delivery_runs_merged_verdict_ck
delivery_runs_merged_verdict_ck.value: "delivery_runs"."merged_at" IS NULL OR "delivery_runs"."verdict" IS NOT NULL

hatch_messages_reply_length_ck.name: hatch_messages_reply_length_ck
hatch_messages_reply_length_ck.value: "reply" IS NULL OR length("reply") BETWEEN 1 AND 2000

hatch_messages_replied_ck.name: hatch_messages_replied_ck
hatch_messages_replied_ck.value: ("hatch_messages"."reply" IS NULL) = ("hatch_messages"."replied_at" IS NULL) AND ("hatch_messages"."reply" IS NULL) = ("hatch_messages"."run_id" IS NULL)

hatch_messages_refusal_ck.name: hatch_messages_refusal_ck
hatch_messages_refusal_ck.value: "hatch_messages"."refusal" IS NULL OR ("hatch_messages"."reply" IS NOT NULL AND "hatch_messages"."refusal" IN ('spec_in_flight', 'map_uncleared', 'spec_approved', 'ticket_set_approved', 'no_ticket_set', 'waypoint_not_waiting', 'waypoint_state', 'spec_waiting'))

hatch_messages_change_ck.name: hatch_messages_change_ck
hatch_messages_change_ck.value: "hatch_messages"."change" IS NULL OR ("hatch_messages"."reply" IS NOT NULL AND "hatch_messages"."refusal" IS NULL)

maps_destination_confirmed_ck.name: maps_destination_confirmed_ck
maps_destination_confirmed_ck.value: "maps"."destination_confirmed_at" IS NULL OR "maps"."destination" IS NOT NULL

planning_runs_one_running_per_map.name: planning_runs_one_running_per_map
planning_runs_one_running_per_map.where: "planning_runs"."state" = 'running' AND "planning_runs"."waypoint_id" IS NULL AND "planning_runs"."specification_id" IS NULL AND "planning_runs"."purpose" <> 'hatch'

planning_runs_error_ck.name: planning_runs_error_ck
planning_runs_error_ck.value: ("planning_runs"."state" = 'failed') = ("planning_runs"."error_code" IS NOT NULL) AND ("planning_runs"."error_code" IS NULL) = ("planning_runs"."error_message" IS NULL)

planning_runs_cancel_reason_ck.name: planning_runs_cancel_reason_ck
planning_runs_cancel_reason_ck.value: ("planning_runs"."state" = 'cancelled') = ("planning_runs"."cancel_reason" IS NOT NULL) AND ("planning_runs"."cancel_reason" IS NULL OR "planning_runs"."cancel_reason" IN ('replaced', 'reopened'))

planning_runs_hatch_message_ck.name: planning_runs_hatch_message_ck
planning_runs_hatch_message_ck.value: CASE "planning_runs"."purpose" WHEN 'hatch' THEN "planning_runs"."hatch_message_id" IS NOT NULL WHEN 'to_spec' THEN 1 WHEN 'to_tickets' THEN 1 ELSE "planning_runs"."hatch_message_id" IS NULL END

question_rounds_withdrawn_ck.name: question_rounds_withdrawn_ck
question_rounds_withdrawn_ck.value: ("question_rounds"."status" = 'withdrawn') = ("question_rounds"."withdrawn_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("question_rounds"."withdrawn_at" IS NULL) = ("question_rounds"."withdrawn_reason" IS NULL) AND ("question_rounds"."withdrawn_reason" IS NULL OR "question_rounds"."withdrawn_reason" IN ('superseded', 'waypoint_out_of_scope'))

spec_revisions_rejection_reason_ck.name: spec_revisions_rejection_reason_ck
spec_revisions_rejection_reason_ck.value: "spec_revisions"."rejection_reason" IS NULL OR "spec_revisions"."superseded_at" IS NOT NULL

waypoints_resolution_ck.name: waypoints_resolution_ck
waypoints_resolution_ck.value: ("waypoints"."status" = 'resolved') = ("waypoints"."resolution" IS NOT NULL) AND ("waypoints"."status" = 'resolved') = ("waypoints"."gist" IS NOT NULL) AND ("waypoints"."status" = 'resolved') = ("waypoints"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("waypoints"."status" = 'resolved') = ("waypoints"."resolved_how" IS NOT NULL)

waypoints_resolved_by_run_ck.name: waypoints_resolved_by_run_ck
waypoints_resolved_by_run_ck.value: ("waypoints"."resolved_by_run" IS NOT NULL) = ("waypoints"."resolved_how" IS NOT NULL AND "waypoints"."resolved_how" = 'run')

write_actor_actor_ck.name: write_actor_actor_ck
write_actor_actor_ck.value: CASE "write_actor"."actor_kind" WHEN 'user' THEN "write_actor"."actor_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "write_actor"."actor_run_id" IS NULL WHEN 'system' THEN "write_actor"."actor_user_id" IS NULL AND "write_actor"."actor_run_id" IS NULL ELSE "write_actor"."actor_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "write_actor"."actor_run_id" IS NOT NULL END
